name: Talaan
notes: Talaan V2.5.0 adds household groups, equal, percentage, and exact expense shares, payer tracking, member balances, and explicit settlements. Personal reports count only the owner's share while Account Ledger payments retain the complete amount actually paid. Settlements never create income, expenses, paid state, or automatic account movements. Dashboard Calendar, Cash Flow, and Overview now share a stable full-width 14px/12px layout while saved card preferences remain available in Customize mode. Sidebar navigation keeps its 60px collapsed and 185px expanded desktop widths while adding consistent selection states and a safe-area-aware phone drawer. Finance Schema 12 and Cloud Schema V3 are preserved. The phone Budget view leads with Money remaining at 32px and Outstanding expenses, offers a Monthly breakdown disclosure, uses readable two-row month navigation and 44px primary touch targets, and keeps the closed drawer out of keyboard focus. Phone Planning labels fit their rows and repeated expense actions use compact widths, centered content, and 8px gaps. Available money and expense-period headers keep totals beside centered controls and wrap longer content. Phone unpaid expenses support right swipe selection and left swipe actions, with an accessible keyboard alternative. Monthly breakdown centers its disclosure arrow and label. The one-time UI refresh advances to talaan12 while the application version and finance cache identity stay unchanged.
